title: dba-admin-scripts: generic database and AWS command-line scripts
description: General-purpose command-line scripts for database and cloud administration, covering routine administration, reporting, backup and restore, and setup tasks. Written to be readable and adaptable rather than tied to a particular deployment. Published by the Database Administration team at the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics (LASP), University of Colorado Boulder.
